text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The day of the showdown is almost upon us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes, the current goal, is 
still six months away. Was there something 
else?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's the "Fan Thanksgiving," you see. Even 
the sound of it is lovely: "Fan 
Thanksgiving."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, interacting with fans is 
the first step toward getting official URA 
merchandise made.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We'll get even closer here, and with 
lovely power, I'll grab their heart tight 
and never let go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is an important job that simply must 
be done. We must do our very best, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'd like to hold a meeting to 
brainstorm plans for the festival events.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've come up with tons of ideas for now. 
Since it's the Spring Fan Fest, let's have 
lots of sports—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Three-legged race with Chan, playing catch 
with Chan, thumb-wrestling tournament with 
Chan, ring toss tournament, bowling, and 
gateball.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Pick out two of them, perhaps... No, doing 
all of them is an option too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying on like that, more mindful of the 
Fan Appreciation Festival than anyone 
else, she pressed forward with 
preparations—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And finally, the day arrived!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "I seem to have caught a cold..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was going to pretend I was fine and go 
anyway, but Fuji-san stopped me...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It makes me sad that I can't see the fans. 
But I can't risk getting them sick, 
either...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"‘That's why, I'm sorry. I'll be taking 
some time off... *sniff*...’"
choice_data_list: Okay, take your time and rest

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's disappointing, but we can't risk 
letting your cold get any worse.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-san. May I ask a favor of 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Could you connect via video call and walk 
around the Fan Appreciation Festival for 
us?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe there are children who came just 
because they wanted to see Machan."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan thinks that if it's just chatting in 
secret, she can do that, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, considering her recent performances, 
there are bound to be plenty of fans who 
came just to catch a glimpse of Aston 
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After promising not to overdo it, I 
decided to take my smartphone and wander 
around the academy. However—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, time for the fan beanbag toss 
tournament! Team Hishi Ama is definitely 
gonna win, so get fired up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon's Fans
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, here we goー♪ Who's the cutest 
of them allー?

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text: Curren Chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after walking and searching every 
last corner for fans who might be looking 
for Aston Machanâ

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fan
text_block_list.text: Vodka-chan! Is your injury all better now?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, totally fine, totally fine! Sorry I 
couldn't show you me running overseas, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Daska's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um, here, I wrote a letter for 
Scarlet-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Daska's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I am so, sooo looking forward to facing 
Vodka-chan at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you so much! I'm so happy! 
I'll do my best in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not once did I hear anyone lamenting Aston 
Machan's absence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering Aston Machan's success, it 
felt unnatural. Surely they just happened 
to miss it.
choice_data_list: Let's try going around one more time

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
""...No, I'm alright. Thank you, 
Trainer.""

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you simply missed each other. 
...Even if not, one should enjoy talking 
with the Umamusume who are here rather 
than dwelling on those who aren't.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan would have done the same if she were 
a visitor. After all, it's a festival.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is all right. Machan's mark was just 
too shallow.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I will do my best in our next race. ...So 
it is fine."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your trouble. Chan-me 
will sleep soundly now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please enjoy the Fan Thanksgiving 
Festi—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The sound of the waves again...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Could it mean that it's getting close 
already?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, Trainer, are you heading to 
the Thanksgiving Festival after this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had free time, but... somehow, enjoying 
myself while leaving her behind felt 
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You see, it must be because of my cold, 
but I feel terribly lonely inside.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So... Chan-me is going to head over to the 
trainer's office now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll bundle up properly. I'll take a 
blanket and stay quietly on the sofa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, paying no mind to anyone 
trying to stop her, Aston Machan showed up 
carrying a blanket over her shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I brought a movie with me. It's my 
favorite spy film."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Let's watch it together. It's definitely 
going to be fun. Right?"
choice_data_list:
(She's being much more affectionate than 
usual.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she didn't put it into words, she 
might have been quite shocked.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's watch it together.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "...Ehe. Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the quiet Trainer's room, we huddled 
close together, watching the fast-paced 
movie unfold.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
............ Hehe, I really love this 
scene.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly, cheers can be heard from 
outside the window.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And as expected, it's neck and neck! A 
battle between the two! Will it be Vodka 
or Scarlet?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
... ...Everyone's getting quite excited, 
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list:
...Let's make the next Fan Appreciation 
Festival a success.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Next time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right. There's always next 
time. Next time for sure—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The sound of the waves again...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Could it mean that it's getting close 
already?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's nothing.
